fields.name: _dfgdia_iso3_country_std_cnty
fields.meaning: ISO three-letter export country code; not a GPS location.

fields.name: df_mapping_start_time
fields.meaning: Start of this record's upstream mapping step, in UTC; precise pipeline semantics are undocumented.

fields.name: df_mapping_end_time
fields.meaning: End of this record's upstream mapping step, in UTC; precise pipeline semantics are undocumented.

fields.name: df_mapping_type
fields.meaning: Upstream mapping format code; the delivered file format is JSON.

fields.name: df_process_start_time
fields.meaning: Start of this record's upstream processing step, in UTC; precise pipeline semantics are undocumented.

fields.name: df_process_end_time
fields.meaning: End of this record's upstream processing step, in UTC; precise pipeline semantics are undocumented.

fields.name: scvcmf_appl_cntxt_2
fields.meaning: Application context code; its expansion is not defined in the export.

fields.name: scvcmf_asset_d_2
fields.meaning: Vehicle asset URI or identifier; its exact encoding is not defined.

fields.name: scvcmf_dev_typ_c_2
fields.meaning: Telematics module or device type code.

fields.name: scvcmf_flow_n_2
fields.meaning: Source feed or processing flow name.

fields.name: scvcmf_partition_cntry_c
fields.meaning: Data partition country code; not vehicle position.

fields.name: scvcmf_sha_k
fields.meaning: Source-record key with a SHA-like representation; used to identify repeated records.

fields.name: scvcmf_vin_n_2
fields.meaning: Vehicle Identification Number.

fields.name: scvcmf_cond_met_x_2
fields.meaning: Metric name or comma-separated names associated with a snapshot or trigger. WINDOW_STATUS appears as a label, but no window-state value field is exported.

fields.name: scvcmf_cond_x_2
fields.meaning: Condition that triggered an event, such as a changed charging or plug status.

fields.name: scvcmf_event_typ_c_2
fields.meaning: Event kind: TriggeredEvent or StateTransition.

fields.name: scvcmf_met_kind_2
fields.meaning: Metric kind code, such as GAUGE.

fields.name: scvcmf_pyld_d_2
fields.meaning: Event or state-transition AUI identifier; this is a string, not nested payload data.

fields.name: scvcmf_pyld_typ_c_2
fields.meaning: Logical record type: Metric, Event, or CommandRequest.

fields.name: scvcmf_sig_typ_c_2
fields.meaning: Signal type: telemetry, event, or command.

fields.name: scvcmf_src_2
fields.meaning: Backend service or instance that emitted an event.

fields.name: scvcmf_well_kn_lbl_x_2
fields.meaning: Standardized uppercase label for a vehicle event.

fields.name: scvcmf_wk_event_n_2
fields.meaning: Snake-case name of a vehicle event.

fields.name: scvcmf_wk_event_strt_time_s_2
fields.meaning: Event start/occurrence timestamp in UTC.

fields.name: scvcmf_wks_strt_time_s_2
fields.meaning: Source telemetry or work-set timestamp in UTC; the exact meaning of WKS is not defined.

fields.name: scvcmf_xev_batt_chg_dsply_stat_2.chg_pwr_typ
fields.meaning: Charging power type: AC, DC, or UNKNOWN. This is not a numeric power reading.

fields.name: scvcmf_xev_batt_chg_dsply_stat_2.chg_stat_orgn
fields.meaning: Origin of a charging-status report: IN_VEHICLE or STATION; not the charging location.

fields.name: scvcmf_xev_batt_chg_dsply_stat_2.xev_batt_chg_dsply_stat_val
fields.meaning: Displayed charging state, such as IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, or NOT_PLUGGED_IN.

fields.name: scvcmf_xev_batt_chg_engy_out_2.met_unt
fields.meaning: Unit for the charger energy-output reading (kWh).

fields.name: scvcmf_xev_batt_chg_engy_out_2.xev_batt_chg_engy_out_val
fields.meaning: Reported battery-charger energy-output reading. It behaves as a running charge counter and can stop updating before a session ends; it is not wall-meter consumption.

fields.name: scvcmf_xev_batt_rng_2.met_unt
fields.meaning: Unit for estimated battery range (km).

fields.name: scvcmf_xev_batt_rng_2.xev_batt_rng_val
fields.meaning: Estimated remaining driving range from the battery.

fields.name: scvcmf_xev_batt_st_chg_2.met_unt
fields.meaning: Unit for battery state of charge (%).

fields.name: scvcmf_xev_batt_st_chg_2.xev_batt_st_chg_val
fields.meaning: Battery state of charge.

fields.name: scvcmf_xev_batt_time_to_full_chg_2
fields.meaning: Estimated remaining time to full charge. The export supplies no unit and occasional outliers occur.

fields.name: scvcmf_xev_chg_stn_pwr_typ_2
fields.meaning: Charger class: AC_BASIC, DC_FAST, or UNKNOWN; not measured kW.

fields.name: scvcmf_xev_plug_chg_stat_2
fields.meaning: Charging plug/cable connection state: CONNECTED or DISCONNECTED.

fields.name: scvcmf_pos_val_2.gps_datum
fields.meaning: Geodetic reference system code for the GPS position.

fields.name: scvcmf_pos_val_2.gps_dimension
fields.meaning: GPS point dimensionality code.

fields.name: scvcmf_pos_val_2.gps_mdul_s
fields.meaning: Timestamp produced by the GPS module, in UTC.

fields.name: scvcmf_pos_val_2.gps_mdul_s__msk
fields.meaning: Opaque __msk companion to the GPS time; it does not provide a second usable timestamp.

fields.name: scvcmf_pos_val_2.three_d_point_val.latitude
fields.meaning: Latitude in decimal degrees; source precision may be coarse.

fields.name: scvcmf_pos_val_2.three_d_point_val.latitude__msk
fields.meaning: Opaque __msk companion to latitude; it does not restore finer position precision.

fields.name: scvcmf_pos_val_2.three_d_point_val.longitude
fields.meaning: Longitude in decimal degrees; source precision may be coarse.

fields.name: scvcmf_pos_val_2.three_d_point_val.longitude__msk
fields.meaning: Opaque __msk companion to longitude; it does not restore finer position precision.

fields.name: scvcmf_door_lock_stat_2.deter_methd
fields.meaning: Method by which the door-lock state was determined.

fields.name: scvcmf_door_lock_stat_2.door_lock_stat_val
fields.meaning: Door-lock state: LOCKED or UNLOCKED.

fields.name: scvcmf_door_lock_stat_2.veh_door
fields.meaning: Which door the lock state applies to, including side doors and inner tailgate.

fields.name: scvcmf_door_stat_2.door_stat_val
fields.meaning: Door open/closed state: AJAR or CLOSED.

fields.name: scvcmf_door_stat_2.veh_door
fields.meaning: Which door the open/closed state applies to.

fields.name: scvcmf_hood_stat_2
fields.meaning: Hood state: AJAR or CLOSED.

fields.name: scvcmf_ign_stat_2
fields.meaning: Ignition state: ON or OFF.

fields.name: scvcmf_ind_lite_2.ind_val.addl_info.typ
fields.meaning: Protocol-buffer type of the indicator additional information.

fields.name: scvcmf_ind_lite_2.ind_val.addl_info.val
fields.meaning: Additional warning code; decoding is not provided.

fields.name: scvcmf_ind_lite_2.ind_val.ind_st
fields.meaning: Indicator lamp state: ON or OFF.

fields.name: scvcmf_ind_lite_2.ind_val.well_kn_ind
fields.meaning: Well-known indicator identity, such as a tire-pressure warning.

fields.name: scvcmf_odom_2.met_unt
fields.meaning: Odometer unit (km).

fields.name: scvcmf_odom_2.odom_val
fields.meaning: Cumulative vehicle odometer reading.

fields.name: scvcmf_vwhl_torque_stat_2
fields.meaning: Wheel-torque status, seen as OFF during remote-start events; precise operational meaning is not documented.

fields.name: scvcmf_crltn_d_2
fields.meaning: Correlation identifier linking command and state-transition messages.

fields.name: scvcmf_fsm_n_2
fields.meaning: Name of the command/actuation state machine, such as actuation_lock.

fields.name: scvcmf_from_st_2
fields.meaning: State before a command state transition.

fields.name: scvcmf_metdta_tags_2.command_type
fields.meaning: Remote command name, such as lock, unlock, remoteStart, or charging control.

fields.name: scvcmf_metdta_tags_2.veh_aui
fields.meaning: Vehicle AUI/identifier attached to command metadata.

fields.name: scvcmf_metdta_tags_2.wakeup_reqstd
fields.meaning: Text value indicating whether the command requests a vehicle wake-up.

fields.name: scvcmf_msg_x_2
fields.meaning: Command lifecycle or error text, such as queued, delivered, success, failure, or timeout; not a message sent by a person.

fields.name: scvcmf_oem_crltn_d_2
fields.meaning: OEM-side correlation identifier for an event or command trace.

fields.name: scvcmf_remote_strt_countdown_timer_2.met_unt
fields.meaning: Unit for a remote-start countdown timer.

fields.name: scvcmf_remote_strt_countdown_timer_2.remote_strt_countdown_timer_val
fields.meaning: Remote-start countdown timer value.

fields.name: scvcmf_to_st_2
fields.meaning: State after a command state transition.

fields.name: scvcmf_trigr_2
fields.meaning: Named trigger/cause of a state transition.

fields.name: scvcmf_veh_commn_crltn_d_2
fields.meaning: Vehicle-communication correlation identifier.

fields.name: scvcmf_ccs_dta_sync_st_x_2
fields.meaning: Configuration or consent data synchronization status; CCS expansion is not provided.

fields.name: scvcmf_cnsnt_x
fields.meaning: Opaque consent code; do not infer opt-in state from its digits alone.

fields.name: scvcmf_consentcode_binary_x
fields.meaning: Opaque numeric-looking consent code; its bits or digits are not decoded here.

fields.name: scvcmf_enty_lst_x_2
fields.meaning: Serialized consent entity entries: a non-JSON {value=[...]} wrapper around a JSON array. See embedded elements below.

fields.name: scvcmf_ftcp_ver_x_3
fields.meaning: Protocol or software version; FTCP expansion is not provided.

fields.name: scvcmf_plcy_tbl_extn_dta_x_2
fields.meaning: JSON-encoded policy-table version and fingerprint metadata; see embedded elements below.

fields.name: scvcmf_usr_friendly_msg_dta_x_2
fields.meaning: JSON-encoded version and fingerprint metadata for user-friendly-message data, not message text.

embedded.meaning: Outer array of consent entities; the surrounding value text is not valid JSON as-is.
Numeric entity/feature identifier; no code-to-feature lookup is supplied.
Sequence or version identifier for the consent entry; absent on some entries.
Timestamp of the consent-entry state, in UTC.
SHA-256 digest/fingerprint; the input being hashed is not specified and this is not a biometric field.
Platform version component; detailed version scheme is undocumented.
Timestamp of this version metadata, in UTC.
SHA-256 digest/fingerprint; the input being hashed is not specified and this is not a biometric field.
